resolvedGaps.appearancePolicy: Reuse the independently specified visual variation; never infer appearance from a driver name or identify a real person.
resolvedGaps.generationPrompt: Create a realistic square professional profile photograph of a wholly fictional adult fleet professional for a fleet-management Demo. This is not a real person and must not resemble a celebrity or public figure. Use head-and-shoulders framing, an eye-level camera, a natural focused expression, soft even professional lighting, and circular-avatar safe margins. Give this fictional variation a mid-career presentation, short straight hair, a plain deep-green polo under a neutral utility jacket, and a softly blurred logistics operations room background. Keep the face as the clear focus. Use no text, logos, branding, licence cards, watermarks, identifiable vehicle model, or dramatic cinematic styling. Keep the entire head and both shoulders in frame, with generous circular-avatar-safe margins. NO TEXT ANYWHERE IN IMAGE. NO DRIVER ID. NO DRIVER NAME. NO CAPTION. NO BADGE. NO WATERMARK. These exclusions apply to foreground clothing and every background object. No government, police or military insignia. Do not depict an identifiable vehicle or assigned plate.
negativeConstraints: no text, logos, company branding, or watermark
no visible licence, ID card, badge, or name tag
no police, military, government uniform, or insignia
no identifiable assigned vehicle or readable third-party advertising
no cartoon, illustration, fashion editorial, passport-photo, or cinematic treatment
no exaggerated expression, cluttered background, or anatomy artifacts
no government, police or military insignia
